headline: Distinct member and investor journeys from entrance to workspace

items.title: A distinct Vault Member sign-in and creation experience
items.insight: The existing creation panel sends new members through a sign-in-first screen with dense technical instructions and no clear audience choice. Create a branded two-audience entry, redesign member sign-in/create/profile-completion states, preserve referral and return intent, and present invite requirements honestly. Keep Obelisk credentials and existing membership policy authoritative.
items.evidence: Real browser sign-in/create/profile/recovery states are readable and navigable across all seven themes and desktop/mobile; current authenticated member and invited onboarding journeys return to the correct member context.

items.title: Restore the premium Investor Relations journey and workspace
items.insight: The structurally separate investor portal has an application mislabeled Create account, hardcoded dashboard returns, and no consumed submission confirmation. Create a premium institutional investor entrance and consistent workspace shell across all subpages. Separate identity creation, investor access request and approval; consolidate the application into its existing route; preserve safe investor destinations and accurate browser submission confirmation. Do not change approval tiers, permissions or financial/private data.
items.evidence: All investor routes and states receive real rendered review across themes and viewports. Existing approved investors retain exact deep links; signed-in ordinary members can request access without logout or investor data; application failure/retry/confirmation is accurate without inventing server status.

items.title: Preserve audience and initiating mode through secure identity recovery
items.insight: Member failures change sign-in into registration, and invalid/expired callback failures default to membership even for investors. Preserve trusted initiating intent and audience in the existing signed flow. Use a neutral audience chooser when no trusted flow survives; preserve fail-closed state, nonce, PKCE and access gates. Verify provider-supported signup behavior before promising it; coordinate owner dependencies through Ark.
items.evidence: Regression tests prove cancellation, provider errors, expiry, invalid state and hostile return targets remain fail closed with correct audience recovery. Affected real authorized member/investor/private-data journeys are required separately; anonymous denials and fixtures do not substitute.
